scope: mneves-socratic-tutor candidate checks; review, acceptance and release results bind through the private gate records and the annotated v1.47.0 tag

checks.name: trials written first, upstream baseline
checks.evidence: 15 cases; upstream met 10 on Sonnet and 10 on Haiku, failing C04/C10 (untested scored 0/5) and C05 (mechanism explained) on both

checks.name: trials on the adapted skill
checks.evidence: shipped text (v6), 18 cases, three samples per model: Sonnet 18/18 in all three samples, Haiku 17, 18 and 18 (one C07 partial: an inline question about the out-of-range level), no failures; map arithmetic correct; C05-C07 and C16-C18 read in full in every sample, other outputs read at the opening and closing lines; corrects the 15/15 first reported in a88fdc9 and the 'no failures' claimed for v4 in 2843773

checks.name: independent review
checks.evidence: fresh-context reviewer, 14 cases and 27 runs with mutant controls: PASS; its three text findings (third failure never explained, two-level map, bar rounding) are fixed and met as C17/C18; a final cross-model review found the v4 grading overstated and drove v5 and v6

checks.name: Agent Skills spec and installer discovery
checks.evidence: 25 root skills validated; npx skills add . --list found 25 including the new skill; MIT license byte-identical to upstream

checks.name: site, model-default and readiness guards
checks.evidence: build-site.test, check-defaults-block (1.47.0, 2026-11-09) and its controls, readiness catalog and its controls

checks.name: repository suites
checks.evidence: pre-commit hook, SRS, pr-wait, Pages guard, ship-deploy contract, codex-lane, ast-grep, diff check

checks.name: local browser
checks.evidence: copy cases, overflow at 390px and 1440px, light/dark contrast; new card, release note, guide navigation and keyboard focus at both widths

checks.name: complexity
checks.evidence: cccc 1.8.0 on skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview (1 file, 0 parse errors): ensure_claude_isolation_supported 15/14 -> 16/14 cognitive/cyclomatic after extracting claude_version_floor (4/4) and claude_model_min_version (2/3); the rest of the change is Markdown, JSON or patch text, which cccc does not analyse

checks.name: native host selection
checks.reason: trials supply the skill file; catalog selection on a host is not exercised
